from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urljoin, urlsplit
import hashlib, json, re

class BoardLinks(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)
        self.href = None
        self.label = []
        self.links = {}

    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag == 'a':
            self.href = dict(attrs).get('href')
            self.label = []

    def handle_data(self, data):
        if self.href:
            self.label.append(data)

    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag != 'a' or not self.href:
            return
        url = urlsplit(urljoin(base, self.href))
        label = ' '.join(''.join(self.label).split())
        if url.scheme == 'https' and url.netloc == 'www.drupal.org' and label and (re.fullmatch(r'/node/\d+/?', url.path) or re.match(r'/forum/[^/]+/.+', url.path)):
            path = url.path.rstrip('/')
            previous = self.links.get(path, '')
            if len(label) > len(previous):
                self.links[path] = label
        self.href = None

source = Path('products/services/drupal-paid-export/raw/paid-services-board.html')

assert digest == '6105fe81148f609fb42c5d044f994796043e9d9d77c536050f98e11fb1facf28', 'Board capture differs from FETCH receipt'
parser = BoardLinks()
parser.feed(raw.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'))
terms = re.compile(r'\b(migrat\w*|export\w*|import\w*|reconcil\w*|csv|spreadsheet|convert\w*)\b', re.I)
links = [{'url': 'https://www.drupal.org' + path, 'label': label, 'title_scope_hint': bool(terms.search(label))} for path, label in parser.links.items() if path != urlsplit(base).path]
links.sort(key=lambda link: not link['title_scope_hint'])
result = {'source': base, 'receipt': 'TASK-179518896101', 'sha256': digest, 'links_extracted': len(links), 'scope_hint_count': sum(link['title_scope_hint'] for link in links), 'links': links[:40], 'coverage': 'Board-link shortlist only. Verify current status, buyer authorship, compensation, forum rules, input rights and response route on original sources before selecting a request.'}
out = Path('products/services/drupal-paid-export/board-link-screen.json')
out.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({key: result[key] for key in ('receipt', 'sha256', 'links_extracted', 'scope_hint_count')}))
print(json.dumps(links[:6]))
